_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to your PROJECT (not the skill), e.g. <project>/schema/families.<corpus>.json, and edit. Paths in `glob` are relative to build_marts.py --root. One block per metric family; the generic loader applies it.

rollups._note: weighted aggregate region->division by PREFIX; weight a rate metric by a count metric
weighted aggregate branch->division by an EXPLICIT crosswalk (arbitrary, non-prefixable). Inline dict here; or set crosswalk to a path to a JSON {branch: division} (resolved relative to this config).

derived._note: ratio metric = numerator/denominator at a grain, computed + cited <derived>; div-by-zero and missing-operand yield no row (honest). scale optional (e.g. 100 for a percent).

coverage._note: OPTIONAL expected roster per family — build emits coverage.json and flags absent months/entities; --strict fails on a violation. Intra-family holes (an entity missing some months) are auto-detected with NO config. Use '*' for a default across families.

families.name: example_tolerant
families._note: template-less exports: no fixed sheet/header; grain inferred from matched dim; entity_regex cleans codes like 'SE1: Name' -> 'SE1'
